product_metadata.title: DOWAN 10" Shallow Serving Bowls, 60 oz Large Serving Bowls and Platters, Serving Plate for Salad Pasta Soup Fruit, Porcelain Serving Dishes for Dinner Party, Set of 2, Turquoise
features: Wide Shallow Serving Bowls: These serving plate bowls are wide and shallow (10*2.36 inch), even large size food can be easily put in, avoid spilling. Great 2.styling and versatile for large dinner salads or serving dishes.
Large Bowls for Salad or Pasta: 10 inches in diameter, 60 oz, ample room for a dinner salad, large pasta, displaying fruit, even multiple component dinners of meat and veggies, rice.
Fashion and Classic Design: Sturdy and stylish, highly stackable to save cabinet space. At the same time easily coordinate with your other tableware and kitchen style.
Quality & Healthy: DOWAN insists on using the top grade porcelain, your family can use it in the dishwasher/microwave/oven/refrigerator anytime.
